_doc: Negative-proof ledger introduced for the fork dependency gate. Exact historical gate paths are excluded until their own controls are changed and proved; future undisclosed gates remain discoverable.

gates.description: Fork PR dependency-bearing changes fail unless a trusted maintainer applies the dependency-review-approved label.

observedFailure.reason: Exited 1 and reported that dependency-bearing files changed without the trusted dependency-review-approved label.
observedFailure.restoredPass: With only README.md modified, the same gate exited 0 and emitted passed=true.

gates.description: Classifies dependency-bearing PR files and enforces explicit trusted-label approval on fork repositories.

observedFailure.reason: Exited 1 for the deliberately unapproved package.json change and named the missing trusted label as the cause.
observedFailure.restoredPass: With only README.md modified, the script exited 0 and emitted passed=true.

gates.description: Runs only an exact local React Doctor package and emits a normalized receipt.

observedFailure.reason: The temporary checkout had no node_modules/react-doctor. The runner returned exit 2 and JSON error pinned-package-missing with outcome=incomplete; no npx or package-manager fallback was available.
observedFailure.restoredPass: The test creates a temporary exact 0.7.8 package whose local analyzer returns JSON; the runner exits 0 with outcome=passed and 64-character package/output hashes.

gates.description: Stops on pre-commit checker failure and preserves real analyzer failures while allowing only the explicit unconfigured state.

observedFailure.command: node --test scripts/run-react-doctor.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="preserves a real analyzer failure exit code"
observedFailure.reason: The temporary exact 0.7.8 analyzer emits valid JSON and exits 23; the runner receipt is outcome=failed, error=analyzer-reported-failure, exitCode=23. The hook allows only exit 2 for missing configuration and exits for any other nonzero status.
observedFailure.restoredPass: The paired local-analyzer test exits 0 with outcome=passed, while the missing-package case remains the explicit disabled receipt path rather than a false quality pass.
